notes.text: The minor in songwriting incorporates practical instruction in the craft of songwriting and in performance skills, instruction in the technology relevant to songwriting, and critical studies in the relevant repertories.
notes.source_line: The minor in songwriting incorporates practical instruction in the craft of songwriting and in performance skills, instruction in the technology relevant to songwriting, and critical studies in the relevant repertories.

notes.text: Requirements for admission: Those who are considering this program should enroll in MUSC 255 Songwriting I. Admission will be based on songwriting ability and potential as determined by the songwriting faculty.
